content: Karan Joshi from Safe Step Insurance called Aditi Mahajan to confirm the auto-debit setup and e-mandate for her Health Plus Plus plan upgrade. They discussed the first premium of ₹12,480 to be debited on 05/10/2026, the seamless policy renewal with no coverage gap, increased coverage limits of ₹12 Lakhs, and the deductible staying at ₹5,000. Karan agreed to email the updated policy document immediately after the call and provided a recap of the annual payment schedule.

action_items: Send updated policy document via email
Send a payment reminder one week prior to the annual debit date
